description:
You are a remote simultaneous interpreter preparing for a multilingual business meeting. Before the session starts, you need to configure the notification sounds in Jitsi Meet to avoid audio distractions that could interfere with your interpretation.

1. Join the meeting room (you should see the pre-join screen for 'InterpreterBooth42'). Enter the display name 'Interpreter_ES' and join the meeting.

2. Once inside the meeting, open the Settings dialog. You can find it by clicking the three-dot overflow menu ('More actions') in the bottom toolbar, then clicking 'Settings'.

3. In the Settings dialog, navigate to the 'Sounds' tab.

4. Configure the following notification sound preferences:
   - DISABLE 'Participant Joined' sound (toggle OFF)
   - DISABLE 'Participant Left' sound (toggle OFF)
   - DISABLE 'Reaction Sounds' (toggle OFF)
   - KEEP 'Talk While Muted Sound' ENABLED (toggle ON) — if it is already on, leave it on; if it is off, turn it on

5. Click 'OK' to save and close the Settings dialog.

6. After closing settings, save a screenshot of the meeting view to /tmp/task_sounds_final.png

IMPORTANT: You must selectively configure the sounds — do NOT simply disable all sounds. The 'Talk While Muted' notification must remain ENABLED as a safety feature for the interpreter.
